title: The 5-hour window starting in the middle of an hour
policy: P15: the window holds records at or after its start. Since #57 its start is rounded down to 15 minutes, not an hour, so it is exact when the provider's reset falls on a quarter hour (unverified, #7); otherwise it can include up to 14 minutes before the start.
derivation: 16:10Z (1) is before the 16:30Z start; 16:40Z (2) and 18:00Z (4) are in: window 6. Before #57 the start was rounded down to 16:00Z, so 16:10Z was included: 7.
